senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Ḥănina, name of several Tannaim and Amoraim. Ḥ. b. Antigonos: Tosef. Arakh. I, 15 (ed. Zuck. חנניא); Arakh. II, 4 (10ᵃ) Talm. ed. (Mish. חנניא).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 6:5">Tem. VI, 5</cite> <cite ref="H01292"><he>חנינא</he></cite>.; <cite ref="Tosefta Temurah 4:10">Tosef. ib. IV, 10</cite> <cite ref="H01316"><he>חנניה</he></cite>.
Bekh. VI, 3; a. fr. (v. Darkhe Mish. p. 128).—Ḥ. b. Gamliel: Macc. III, 15 (23ᵃ) Ms. M. (ed. חנניא).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:1">B. Bath. X, 1</cite>. (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:6">Tosef. Yoma I, 6</cite> <cite ref="H01316"><he>חנניא</he></cite>; Sifra Emor ch. I, Par. 2, a. e. <cite ref="H01316"><he>חנניה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:12">Snh. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ בן גמלא</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—
Nidd. 8ᵃ (v. Darkhe Mish. p. 130).—Ḥ. b. Ḥăkhinai: Kil. IV, 8 (Ms. M. a. Y. חנניה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
Men. 62ᵃ; a. e. (mostly חנניא, הנניה).—Ḥ., S’gan hak-Kohanim (v. סָגָן).

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:1">Eduy. II, 1</cite>; a. fr. (v. Darkhe Mish. p. 59, sq.).—Rabbi Ḥ.: <cite ref="Shabbat 59b:9">Sabb. 59ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. (v. Frank. M’bo, p. 86ᵇ, sq.).—Other Amoraim by that name, v. Frank. l. c. 87ᵇ, sq.—
